about: Example of course/pronunciations.json, from a parallel-computing course. Copy the idea, not the words: list the terms of YOUR subject that the voice must say right. 'spell' is the easy way (plain words, matched exactly as written). 'words' gives exact sounds as Kokoro phonemes ('us' for American voices, 'gb' for British ones), matched as whole words ignoring case. Any all-capital word not listed is read letter by letter, which is right for most acronyms (DNA, ATP); list the ones said as a word (NASA, CUDA) or with their own sounds.
